data.title: 请求体body示例
content:
基本与实例开通请求参数一致（询价可不传 "vpcId","subnetId","securityGroupId"，开通实例需传）
//开通单机实例价格查询
{
    "billMode":1,
    "regionId":"81f7728662dd11ec810800155d307d5b",
    "prodVersion":"2014standard",
    "serverCollation":"Chinese_PRC_CI_AS",
    "mysqlNodeInfoList":[
        {
            "nodeType":"master",
            "instSpec":1,
            "storageType":"SSD",
            "storageSpace":100,
            "prodPerformanceSpec":"4C8G",
            "disks":1,
            "availabilityZoneInfo":[
                {
                    "availabilityZoneName":"az1",
                    "availabilityZoneCount":1,
                    "nodeType":"master"
                }
            ]
        }
    ],
    "period":8,
    "count":1,
    "autoRenewStatus":0,
    "prodId":10012001,
    "hostType":"S7"
}
//开通只读实例价格查询
{
        "period": 1,
        "cpuType": "30",
        "autoRenewStatus": 0,
        "count": 1,
		"instId":"630899563795381948",
        "billMode": "1",
        "prodId": 10001105,
        "prodVersion": "8.0",
        "password": "test1111",
        "regionId": "200000001781",
        "hostType": "S7",
        "name": "test-read",
        "osType": "11",
        "mysqlNodeInfoList": [
                {
                        "instSpec": "1",
                        "disks": 1,
                        "availabilityZoneInfo": [
                                {
                                        "availabilityZoneName": "cn-hb-wh41-hbwh1A-public-ctcloud",
                                        "availabilityZoneCount": 1,
                                        "nodeType": "readNode"
                                }
                        ],
                        "storageSpace": 100,
                        "prodPerformanceSpec": "2C4G",
                        "storageType": "SSD",
                        "nodeType": "readNode"
                }
        ]
}
//开通一主一备实例价格查询
{
    "billMode":1,
    "regionId":"81f7728662dd11ec810800155d307d5b",
    "prodVersion":"2014standard",
    "serverCollation":"Chinese_PRC_CI_AS",

        {
            "nodeType":"master",
